verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figure for the RTX 5080, and nothing states precision (FP16/FP8/FP4/INT8) or sparsity. The first-party pages only mention 'fifth-gen Tensor Cores' and generic AI claims. Community items cite memory bandwidth and relative compute benchmark scores, which are not published tensor throughput and cannot be used to size workloads.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
